user.title: Create an advanced alarm clock
user.description: Step 1 of 7 · Give this independent clock a clear room or purpose name. The wizard will guide you through timing, conditions, behavior, and actions.

source.title: Choose the alarm source
source.description: Step 2 of 7 · Use Clock Advanced's exact weekly alarm times, or trigger when a Home Assistant Schedule helper changes from off to on.

helper_schedule.title: Select a Schedule helper
helper_schedule.description: Step 3 of 7 · The alarm starts at the beginning of every active block. Create or edit the helper under Settings → Devices & services → Helpers.

schedule.title: Weekly schedule
schedule.description: Step 3 of 7 · Enable days independently. Holiday and non-workday times override only enabled days.

behavior.title: Alarm lifecycle
behavior.description: Step 5 of 7 · Repeat cadence and snooze are separate. Timeout covers the complete alarm session, including snoozes.

guards.title: Conditions and blockers
guards.description: Step 4 of 7 · Add only the conditions you need. For advanced logic, expose a template binary sensor and select it as the allow or block entity.

data_description.workday_sensor: When off, today's enabled weekday uses the non-workday time.
data_description.vacation_entity: When on, no alarm is armed and an active alarm is dismissed.
data_description.confirmation_sensor: When on during an active alarm, it dismisses the alarm as confirmed.
data_description.block_non_workdays: Overrides the non-workday time and blocks the alarm whenever the workday sensor is off.
data_description.allow_entity: Examples: person, presence, guest-mode, or a template binary sensor.
data_description.allow_state: Typical states are on or home. The comparison is exact.
data_description.block_entity: Examples: quiet mode, child sleeping, meeting mode, or a template binary sensor.
data_description.block_state: Typical state is on. The comparison is exact.

actions.title: Action phases
actions.description: Step 6 of 7 · Build normal Home Assistant action sequences. All fields are optional and receive the variable clock_advanced.
